review: Actual final Release 60 static PNG visual inspection

identityEvidence.metadataUse: Binds recorded capture identities only. Render counts and metadata are not evidence of visual quality.

conclusion.staticReadability: All 30 weapon types appear in both selected views. Major class silhouettes, palettes, stocks, magazines, sights and attachments are distinguishable. No conspicuous detached stock, receiver/barrel, magazine or optic is observed in the reviewed selected configurations.
conclusion.qualityAcceptance: Visual quality acceptance beyond sampled static coherence is not established. Broad flat faces, coarse optics, simplified anatomy and sparse finish/feed details remain visible.

reviewerProvenance.scope: IDs 15–29, both views: 30 weapon-region contact-sheet crops and 10 separately viewed originals

reviewerProvenance.reviewer: Prior final 16-map reviewer; individual agent identity is not recorded in its report

weaponPairObservations.name: Kestrel AR
weaponPairObservations.observation: Black vented fore-end, receiver, divided magazine silhouette and telescoping stock are visible; no conspicuous join gap in these two frames.

weaponPairObservations.name: Bastion 7
weaponPairObservations.observation: Red-brown stock, grip and fore-end contrast with the dark receiver and bent magazine. The finish reads as broad uniform colour rather than detailed wood.

weaponPairObservations.name: Raptor C
weaponPairObservations.observation: Green bullpup body and rear magazine distinguish the silhouette; receiver, magazine and butt appear joined in the sampled side view.

weaponPairObservations.name: Vesper 9
weaponPairObservations.observation: Compact dark body and long skeletal stock are visible. The tall sight and angular lower assembly remain coarse.

weaponPairObservations.name: Lynx PDW
weaponPairObservations.observation: Green compact body with broad upper rail and a short butt is distinguishable; large plain planar faces dominate.

weaponPairObservations.name: Breach 12
weaponPairObservations.observation: Long barrel, pump section, red-brown stock and side cartridge accents identify the shotgun-like silhouette. Small mechanical detail remains limited.

weaponPairObservations.name: Tempest S
weaponPairObservations.observation: Tan receiver, black vented fore-end and telescoping stock are visible. Divided magazine construction reads as a joined stylized assembly in the side view.

weaponPairObservations.name: Longbow M
weaponPairObservations.observation: Long scoped gun with tan skeletal stock is distinguishable. Both scope supports appear to meet the rail in the sampled side view; the dark rear optic face does not demonstrate aim-down-sights.

weaponPairObservations.name: Warden D
weaponPairObservations.observation: Tan receiver and fore-end with a skeletal stock and dark lower magazine are visible; broad angular surfaces remain apparent.

weaponPairObservations.name: Atlas L
weaponPairObservations.observation: Green box-fed body with copper cartridge row and angular stock is visible. Individual copper rounds lack readable belt links/feed detail in the forward original.

weaponPairObservations.name: Sable P
weaponPairObservations.observation: Compact gray pistol-like body, trigger guard and grip are visible. A very tall repeated block-based optic dominates the compact silhouette.

weaponPairObservations.name: Dire 50
weaponPairObservations.observation: Gray and tan pistol-like body with grip and trigger guard is visible. Tall repeated optic and block-like receiver make its proportions visibly coarse.

weaponPairObservations.name: Field blade
weaponPairObservations.observation: Knife blade, guard and ridged handle are visible in the side view; the forward view primarily exposes its narrow edge. No gun/optic is expected for this item.

weaponPairObservations.name: Harrow B3
weaponPairObservations.observation: Tan receiver and skeletal stock with a dark magazine/vented fore-end are visible; receiver transitions and optic remain simple shapes.

weaponPairObservations.name: Marten 45
weaponPairObservations.observation: Dark compact body with a long skeletal stock and elongated divided lower assembly is visible; the sampled joins do not show a conspicuous open gap.

weaponPairObservations.name: Mako 7
weaponPairObservations.observation: Tan vented fore-end, black receiver, and brown skeletal stock read clearly. Large planar faces and coarse sight frame remain visible.

weaponPairObservations.name: Peregrine 6
weaponPairObservations.observation: Green receiver and tan magazine differentiate this pair. Material treatment remains broad, flat, and minimally varied.

weaponPairObservations.name: Osprey S
weaponPairObservations.observation: Compact body with a tall lower grip/magazine assembly and long skeletal stock. Full side frame confirms the apparent crop truncation is only the contact-sheet crop, not the original image. Structural joins remain visibly coarse.

weaponPairObservations.name: Bison 12
weaponPairObservations.observation: Long barrel, tan block receiver, and green angular stock are visible. Flat faces and simple vent/slot shapes dominate.

weaponPairObservations.name: Talon 338
weaponPairObservations.observation: Scoped long gun is visible in both views. Full forward frame shows an opaque dark rear scope face; its viewing/aiming function cannot be assessed from this hip-fire frame. Cylindrical scope rings are visibly faceted.

weaponPairObservations.name: Rampart 556
weaponPairObservations.observation: Tan body, drum magazine, and short angular black stock are distinguishable. Drum contour and receiver transitions have visibly coarse facets.

weaponPairObservations.name: Spectre SD
weaponPairObservations.observation: Black compact receiver, suppressor-like muzzle cylinder, long skeletal stock, and tall lower assembly are visible. Full side frame contains the complete assembly; contact-sheet crop alone omitted its ends.

weaponPairObservations.name: Krait R
weaponPairObservations.observation: Gray cylindrical body and red-brown grip read as a pistol-like weapon. The tall block-based sight is visually dominant relative to the body in both full originals.

weaponPairObservations.name: Swift 93
weaponPairObservations.observation: Tan compact pistol-like body, black grip, and coarse longitudinal ridges are visible. The same tall block-based sight dominates its silhouette; lower receiver and trigger assembly are simple planar shapes.

weaponPairObservations.name: Storm 68
weaponPairObservations.observation: Tan body, rear tan magazine, short butt, and black vented fore-end distinguish the shape. The forward rail teeth and sight retain coarse angular edges.

weaponPairObservations.name: Needle 57
weaponPairObservations.observation: Green body with ribbed cylindrical under-barrel attachment and skeletal stock. Ribbing is visible but material variation and receiver detail remain sparse.

weaponPairObservations.name: Jackal 12
weaponPairObservations.observation: Tan body with green drum magazine, green fore-end, and short angular stock is readable. Broad plain faces and simple joins remain visible.

weaponPairObservations.name: Sentinel 762
weaponPairObservations.observation: Green box-fed long gun with red-brown stock and a copper cartridge row. Full forward original shows separated uniform cylinders without visibly modeled belt links or a clear feed path; this reads as unfinished ammunition detail at this angle.

weaponPairObservations.name: Heron S
weaponPairObservations.observation: Red-brown fore-end, grip, and stock contrast with black body and magazine. These red-brown parts are uniformly colored and do not show visible wood grain or wear at this capture scale.

weaponPairObservations.name: Paladin 45
weaponPairObservations.observation: Gray slide-like upper body and green grip/lower body read as a compact pistol-like weapon. The tall sight is visually dominant and the lower body/trigger assembly is coarse; full originals show no unintended screenshot-edge clipping beyond normal first-person framing.

sceneObservations.name: blacksite-approach
sceneObservations.observation: Concrete panel seams, apertures, vents, roof housings and entry opening are readable. Player rifle and optic are present; world materials show much more surface variation than the rifle.

sceneObservations.name: blacksite-interior
sceneObservations.observation: Roof trusses, central lit fixture, objective marker/ring, two plant units and exit opening are visible. Interior and weapon are dark; broad plant silhouettes remain faceted.

sceneObservations.name: blacksite-yard
sceneObservations.observation: The camera faces a container door almost filling an opening. Wall and door details render, but the occlusion means this frame gives little evidence of the wider yard or route readability.

sceneObservations.name: blacksite-oblique
sceneObservations.observation: Concrete/asphalt boundaries, stairs, barrier, barrel and sparse distant foliage are visible. No earlier unsupported service rods are visible above the routes in this final frame.

sceneObservations.name: blacksite-services
sceneObservations.observation: Plant casing, motor housing, crates, roof structure and mounted service manifold are visible. No conspicuous detached manifold assembly is observed; low light limits reading of small joints and textures.

sceneObservations.name: weapon-close
sceneObservations.observation: Red-brown rifle fore-end and dark receiver/optic are visible. Broad uniformly coloured parts, large flat faces and an angular support forearm remain evident.

sceneObservations.name: operator-close
sceneObservations.observation: Clothed tactical humanoid has helmet, goggles, vest, bent arms, knee pads and boots. The operator is visibly faceted and shaded dark, with limited small surface/anatomical detail.

sceneObservations.name: combat
sceneObservations.observation: Player rifle, a small muzzle glow, bright ejected-case shape and nearby armed operator are present. The operator is partly hidden by the player weapon; a single still cannot establish effects or combat animation quality.

sceneObservations.name: reload
sceneObservations.observation: Weapon is rotated across the lower-right foreground. Barrel, rail and tilted optic remain visible; a single pose cannot establish a complete magazine exchange, grip contact or animation continuity.

visualQualityFindings.observation: Weapon receivers, stocks, grips and round parts retain large flat faces, coarse bevels and visibly angular silhouettes. Material differentiation relies heavily on uniform black, green, tan and red-brown colour areas; finish, wear and fine mechanical detail are sparse at this capture scale.
visualQualityFindings.impact: The weapon pixels remain visibly stylized/coarse and do not establish AAA visual parity.

visualQualityFindings.observation: The repeated hollow polygon sight and solid rectangular mounting base form a very tall silhouette on the compact pistol-like weapons. The bulk of this generic optic dominates the smaller weapon bodies.
visualQualityFindings.impact: Pistol proportions and optic construction remain coarse and repetitive. No detached optic is inferred from the sampled side views.

visualQualityFindings.observation: Rows of uniform copper cylinders project to the side of the receiver. Belt links and a readable feed transition are not visible in the full forward originals.
visualQualityFindings.impact: The ammunition detail reads as loose-looking or unfinished at this angle. This is an appearance finding; static pixels do not prove a detached runtime mesh or animation fault.

visualQualityFindings.affected: visible first-person hands and operator close-ups
visualQualityFindings.observation: The support forearm/hand has an angular green outline and dark triangular regions with little readable finger/contact detail. The tactical operator has recognizable gear but a dark, faceted silhouette and limited surface/anatomical detail.
visualQualityFindings.impact: Anatomy, hand contact and character material finish remain less developed than a realistic high-detail art target.

visualQualityFindings.observation: Plant machinery is built from broad faceted housings, and distant hills and foliage use simple sparse silhouettes. The Blacksite yard frame is substantially occluded by a container door.
visualQualityFindings.impact: World appearance is readable in the sampled views but these stills provide limited evidence of fine environmental polish or all playable routes.

positiveFindings: All 16 frames show their environment; no missing-texture checkerboards, magenta shader failures or empty world scenes are visible.
Frostline foreground snow and distant snowy hills no longer show the earlier diagonal repeating plaster checker pattern; low-contrast snowfield remains readable.
Monsoon asphalt no longer shows the earlier conspicuous hard cyan quadrilateral puddle tiles. Wet-ground response is restrained in this overview.

Industrial concrete and steel, urban plaster, arid sand, green grass and snowy terrain retain visibly different palettes. Recessed facade apertures, panel seams, roof equipment, stairs and route geometry remain readable.
The final Blacksite oblique player frame no longer contains the four earlier unsupported 23 m service rods over the catwalks.
Nuketown retains coloured houses, open apertures and supported balconies; District retains its elevated route and visible native vehicle.
Final operator-close depicts a clothed tactical humanoid with rounded upper limbs, helmet, goggles, vest, knee pads and boots; the silhouette remains visibly faceted.
limits: One fixed menu/orbit overview per map does not establish player-camera appearance across every location; the displayed menu rifle also occludes part of each overview.
The subdued Monsoon overview resolves the cyan rectangle fault but discrete wet patches are difficult to distinguish at this camera.
Sparse background foliage and faceted distant hills remain simple silhouettes. This review establishes image appearance, not equivalence to AAA mobile art production.
Software WebGL screenshots provide no physical iPhone FPS, GPU-time, thermal or 60 FPS evidence.
Overview appearance does not establish a full play-through of every map or complete animated operator-state coverage.

supplementalMechanicalProof.use: Supplemental source/native contact measurements. It was not used to infer visual quality. This pixel review checks selected captured configurations, not every optic configuration.

limits: This is a static screenshot review of software WebGL renders. It measures neither audio quality nor interactive performance.
The art is still visibly stylized, with coarse shapes and sparse fine surface, mechanical and anatomical detail. No AAA art parity is claimed or established.
No physical iPhone FPS, GPU timing, thermal behavior, sustained frame rate or 60 FPS claim follows from these images.

The primary weapon comparison uses reduced full-frame contact sheets plus fixed crops. Six primary weapon originals and ten secondary originals were separately viewed; the exact methods for each frame are recorded.
Selected side/menu configurations and forward hip-fire views do not cover every attachment, aim-down-sights/reticle, alternative optic, weapon state or animation frame.
One combat still and one reload still do not establish temporal effects, animation continuity, magazine exchange, grip contact or all operator poses.
Low interior light and partial weapon/operator/door occlusion hide some detail. No full map play-through or collision/navigation acceptance is inferred.

The 16-map original inspection is inherited from the existing final-map reviewer and linked by exact matching current PNG hashes. The primary reviewer did not independently view every map original during this turn.

No quality conclusion is inferred from compilation, counts, asset inventories, polygon counts, budgets or successful checks alone. Capture identity comes from recorded scene metadata and exact file hashes.
